title: Exploring promising natural compounds for breast cancer treatment: in silico molecular docking targeting WDR5-MYC protein interaction.
authors: Nagar, Amka; Dubey, Amit; Sharma, Ankur; Singh, Mohini
one_liner_zh: 该文针对WDR5-MYC蛋白-蛋白互作进行分子对接与MD模拟筛选抗癌化合物，对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Cancer is an aberrant differentiation of normal cells, characterized by uncontrolled growth and the potential to acquire invasive and aggressive properties that ultimately lead to metastasis. In the realm of scientific exploration, a multitude of pathways has been investigated and targeted by researchers, among which one specific pathway is recognized as WDR5-MYC. Continuous investigations and research show that WDR5-MYC is a therapeutic target protein. Hence, the discovery of naturally occurring compounds with anticancer properties has been suggested as a rapid and efficient alternative for the development of anticancerous therapeutics. A virtual screening approach was used to identify the most potent compounds from the NP-lib database at the MTiOpenScreen webserver against WDR5-MYC. This process yielded a total of 304 identified compounds. Subsequently, after screening, four potent compounds, namely Estrone (ZINC000003869899), Ethyl-1,2-benzanthracene (ZINC000003157052), Strychnine (ZINC000000119434) and 7H-DIBENZO [C, G] CARBAZOLE (ZINC000001562130), along with a cocrystallized 5-[4-(trifluoromethyl) phenyl]-1H-tetrazole inhibitor (QBP) as a reference ligand, were considered for stringent molecular docking. Thus, each compound exhibited significant docking energy between -8.2 and -7.7 kcal/mol and molecular contacts with essential residue Asn(225), Lys(250), Ser(267) and Lys(272) in the active pocket of WDR5-MYC against the QBP inhibitor (the native ligand QBP serves as a reference in the comparative analysis of docked complexes). The results support the potent compounds for drug-likeness and strong binding affinity with WDR5-MYC protein. Further, the stability of the selected compounds was predicted by molecular dynamics simulation (100 ns) contributed by intermolecular hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic interactions. This demonstrates the potential of the selected compounds to be used against breast cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 癌症是正常细胞的异常分化，其特征为不受控制的生长以及获得侵袭性和攻击性特性，最终导致转移的潜力。在科学探索领域，研究者已研究并靶向众多通路，其中一条特定通路被认定为WDR5-MYC。持续的研究表明，WDR5-MYC是一种治疗靶点蛋白。因此，发现具有抗癌特性的天然化合物已被提议作为开发抗癌治疗药物的快速且高效替代方案。采用虚拟筛选方法，在MTiOpenScreen服务器的NP-lib数据库中识别针对WDR5-MYC的最有效化合物。此过程共获得304种鉴定化合物。随后，筛选后，四种有效化合物，即雌酮 (Estrone, ZINC000003869899)、乙基-1,2-苯并蒽 (Ethyl-1,2-benzanthracene, ZINC000003157052)、士的宁 (Strychnine, ZINC000000119434) 和7H-二苯并[C,G]咔唑 (7H-DIBENZO [C, G] CARBAZOLE, ZINC000001562130)，连同共结晶的5-[4-(三氟甲基)苯基]-1H-四唑抑制剂 (QBP) 作为参考配体，被纳入严格分子对接分析。因此，每种化合物均表现出显著的对接能量，介于-8.2至-7.7 kcal/mol之间，并与WDR5-MYC活性口袋中的关键残基Asn(225)、Lys(250)、Ser(267)和Lys(272)形成分子接触，与QBP抑制剂（天然配体QBP作为对接复合物比较分析中的参考）相比。结果支持这些有效化合物具有药物相似性和与WDR5-MYC蛋白的强结合亲和力。进一步，通过分子动力学模拟（100 ns）预测所选化合物的稳定性，该模拟由分子间氢键和疏水相互作用贡献。这表明所选化合物在乳腺癌治疗中具有潜在应用价值。
